installed_cost_per_watt.unit: USD per watt DC (2025 dollars), gross price before incentives
installed_cost_per_watt.note: Berkeley Lab median installed price for host-owned, stand-alone residential PV installed in FL in 2025, from the chart label on slide 37 of the 2026 Data Update ('State-Level Differences in Installed Prices'). The 20th/80th percentile bars on that chart are not labeled with values and no state percentile table was found, so low and high are null. Caveat: the chart's dotted U.S. reference line sits near $3.0/W while slide 8 shows $3.6/W as the 2025 all-host-owned national median; confirm the state figure against the Berkeley Lab data viewer.

battery_installed_cost.unit: USD for one 13.5 kWh battery system added to a home PV system, installed, before incentives (2024 dollars)
battery_installed_cost.note: National (not state-specific) DOE/NLR Q1 2025 residential benchmark: an 8 kWdc PV system with 13.5 kWh of storage is $4.33/Wdc (MSP, minimum sustainable price) and $4.59/Wdc (MMP, modeled market price); the same 8 kWdc PV-only system is $2.78/Wdc (MSP) and $2.95/Wdc (MMP). Battery cost = (PV+storage - PV-only) x 8,000 Wdc: low = (4.33 - 2.78) x 8,000 = $12,400 (MSP); likely = (4.59 - 2.95) x 8,000 = $13,120 (MMP). The page states no storage adder itself, so this subtraction is ours. High is null: no source states a higher figure (California market data from Berkeley Lab are quoted per kWh for whole PV+storage systems and cannot be isolated).
